scope: Recorded proposal activation on captured live input only, not host execution or strength. 11 boards of three live Deity Science (Online, Indonesia seat) games (civvis-20261105T165539Z, 172506Z, 151911Z), each the run's events.jsonl cut at frame 0 of a turn where no Government Plaza stood or was queued, the capital's Campus stood, the host listed DISTRICT_GOVERNMENT among the capital's buildable items and the capital produced routine work. Both arms run one frozen civvis_orders --resumed built from the branch at a3b8a9fef with the run's own requested genome less the gene's family siblings; the on arm adds --with plaza-serves-the-scientist-3. Orders differ in 10/11 reads. The on arm's claim ('starts the Government Plaza for the Science plaza') is journaled in 10/11 and the off arm's in 0/11; the Plaza is the produced head in 2, and in the other 8 it queues behind work one turn from done (near-done-work-finishes, paused-district-finishes), which the next turn's pass then displaces.
